d: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, has filed for an IPO that could value the five-year-old AI firm at around $2 trillion. The company says sales exceeded $16 billion in the first half of 2026, but it remains deeply unprofitable and has committed more than $800 billion to long-term infrastructure contracts. Its filing also contains an extraordinary warning: advanced AI systems could pose “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity” if misused, weaponised or allowed to operate with high autonomy.
